text:
maya: Heads-up — probe bill jumped ~2.7x this week. Root cause looks like increased frequency of streaming handshake + embeddings probes from two new regions + retries flooding during transient 502s. Thinking we should change sampling and alerting.
cheng: ugh. can you paste the probe-bot failures?
maya: probe-bot below showed cohort of eucentral nodes doing repeated ws 101->502 cycles. logs: 
probe-bot: [1802345601] REGION=eucentral1 PROBE=streaming HANDSHAKE=fail code=502 attempts=3 latency_ms=1200 path=/ws/infer
probe-bot: [1802345620] REGION=eu-west1 PROBE=embeddings HTTP=200 latency_ms=320 payload_tokens=64
sam: notable that embeddings are cheap per call but we have 4x the sample rate than text gen. cost compounds.
oliver: what's current sampling? I thought streaming was 1/min per test host and embeddings 1/30s?
maya: yes — we added extra hosts for cross-region checks and forgot to scale back. current plan:
- reduce streaming probe frequency from 1/min -> 1/5min for non-canary regions
- keep 1/min for canaries (us-east1, eu-west1)
- embeddings probe from 1/30s -> 1/2min with randomized jitter + adaptive backoff on errors
- implement error-bucket cooldown: if a probe gets 5 errors in 10min, pause that probe host for 15min
cheng: I also want to reduce Prometheus cardinality — every probe tag was creating label churn. proposed: drop the 'probe_host' label in metrics and rely on region+probe_type. aggregate histograms to 1m buckets before remote write.
matt: alerting side: current alert fires p95>250ms for embeddings which is noisy. Suggest switch to p99>600ms with a 10m burn rate and a separate immediate alert on error-rate>2% sustained 3m.
sam: agree on two-tier alerts. Also add a 'probe-cost' grafana panel that computes estimated monthly $ from probe-rates x unit-cost so PMs can see it.
maya: for streaming handshake flakiness we traced to NAT translation timeouts and ephemeral SNAT pool exhaustion on a couple k8s nodes. mitigation: bump SNAT pool size + add probe that does a rapid websocket open/close stress (5s interval) only on dedicated test infra, not prod probes.
oliver: can we generate a quick PromQL for p99 streaming latency and active websocket errors?
cheng: try this: 
- p99 latency: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(probe_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{probe_type="streaming"}[5m])) by (le, region))
- ws errors: sum(rate(probe_streaming_handshake_errors_total[5m])) by (region)
matt: also add node-level GPU signal to the synthetic test: if node_gpu_utilization > 85% for 5m, enable a higher-concurrency streaming probe on canaries to exercise tail. metric: avg_over_time(node_gpu_utilization[5m]) > 0.85
sam: we should also limit probe concurrency in the scheduler to avoid amplifying real load during infra incidents. cap concurrent probes per-region to 10 and backoff exponential on 5xx.
maya: proposed rollout:
1) today: drop extra hosts and reduce sampling (low-risk)
2) next week: implement adaptive backoff + error-bucket pause in probe-runner
3) following: add Prometheus relabel to drop probe_host label + remote_write histogram pre-aggregation
4) monitoring: switch embedding alert to p99 burn-rate + add probe-cost panel
5) optional: enable GPU-triggered high-concurrency probes for tail detection (opt-in per region)
cheng: sounds good. I'll open a PR for relabel configs + add tests for prometheus cardinality.
maya: I'll do probe-runner changes and update infra runbook. ping me if you want to test in staging.
probe-bot: [1802345698] CHECK: eucentral1 streaming paused (error-bucket hit). reason=snat-exhaustion cooldown_until=1802346600
matt: nice, that cooldown is already preventing noisy retries.
maya: thanks team — I'll update the incident slack channel and the runbook. :thumbsup:
